name: Bold Subscriptions
summary: Shopify subscription app by Bold: subscribe-and-save, replenishment, prepaid and subscription-box offers with a customer portal, dunning for failed payments, cancellation flows, upsells and free migration from other subscription apps.
best_for: Shopify stores starting or running subscribe-and-save, replenishment, prepaid or subscription-box offers that want unlimited subscribers, dunning and a customer portal from the entry plan, with free migration from another subscription app
skip_if: your subscription revenue is already large and you would rather pay a flat fee than a percentage that keeps growing; you need a guarantee of fast human support (every plan lists standard support); or you cannot accept an app that views sensitive customer data and edits orders
honest_knock: Bold Subscriptions never stops charging a percentage. Every plan adds a transaction fee of 0.9% to 2% on top of the monthly price, so the bill grows with your subscription revenue: at $30,000 a month it is about $350 even on the best plan. The higher plans buy nothing but that lower fee, and all three list the same standard support. The recent reviews we read are uneven: praise for chat support sits beside a merchant double-charged for nearly three years after a version merge (June 2026), a store down for 48 hours after an app update with no refund offered (February 2026), and a week without an answer to support emails (May 2026). The data access is wide, including viewing sensitive customer data and editing orders. We have not run the app ourselves; this dossier is read from the listing and its reviews.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Launch · per month, plus a 2% transaction fee
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-05 on the Shopify App Store listing at apps.shopify.com/bold-subscriptions, prices in USD) Three plans, each a monthly fee plus a transaction fee, and each with a 30-day free trial. Launch is $24.99 a month plus a 2% transaction fee and already includes the working core: subscription maximizers, customizable frequencies, order-based and fixed-date billing, dunning, prepaid subscriptions, unlimited subscribers and standard support. Grow is $49.99 a month plus 1%, and Scale is $74.99 a month plus 0.9%. The listing names no feature that Grow or Scale adds beyond the lower fee; the support line reads 'Standard support' on all three. All charges are billed in USD, and recurring and usage-based charges are billed every 30 days. The listing does not say which transactions the fee is charged on; we read it as the subscription orders the app processes, and that is worth confirming before you install.

compare_with.name: rePete
compare_with.why: rePete is in our dossiers too, and it comes from the same company: Bold builds both. They answer the same question from opposite ends. Bold Subscriptions locks customers into a schedule and charges $24.99 to $74.99 a month plus a 0.9% to 2% fee on the orders it processes. rePete has no subscription at all: it predicts when each customer is due to reorder, nudges them, and takes 3% of reorders within 24 hours, 1% within seven days and 5% on add-ons, with no monthly fee. Bold's own homepage positions them together, subscriptions for customers who want a schedule and rePete for those who refuse one. If most of your repeat buyers will not subscribe, rePete is the one to model first; if they will, compare Bold's fee against your subscription revenue at the plan you would actually sit on.
